digest.component_or_area: plan-review criteria vocabulary and detector infrastructure
propositions: Success Criteria and Acceptance Criteria are semantically identical in rebar's plan vocabulary, yet both headings coexist—causing criteria under SC to evade checkbox counting, operator attestation, and individual checkability

Collapsing SC into AC as a unified heading requires migrating detector regexes, reviewer prompts, criteria routing, author guides, generated guides, test fixtures, and 106 store tickets from bullet-list SC to checkbox-format AC items

The dod_uncertifiable wording ('definition of done / success criterion') in plan_review_verifier.md, plan_review_verifier_agentic.md, and verify_models.py must be preserved as it is a separate concept outside this collapse

Generic English prose references to 'success criteria' in plan_review_T2.md (pilot metrics) and O-RAN-SC (Linux Foundation consortium), minified vendor bundles, and historical test fixtures must survive the collapse without being rewritten

Post-migration verification must confirm zero SC headings remain, all 106 tickets carry migrated AC checkboxes, and the regenerated criteria guide contains exactly one SC prose match (from excluded T2 prompt)

The epic's initial acceptance criteria were mutually unsatisfiable due to contradictions with child stories' scopes and generated artifact mechanics, requiring four criteria amendments before closure was viable
